card: This pull request fixes an intermittent test failure in p2p_orphan_handling.py. The test previously relied on a ping-pong roundtrip to wait for a peer disconnection to clear orphan state, but node deletion and orphan state updates could be delayed if the message handler thread still held a node reference. The PR changes the test to explicitly wait until node.getorphantxs reflects that the disconnected peer was removed. A CI run failure log and a reproduction diff were provided by the author.
evidence: PR description links to a concrete CI failure run: https://github.com/bitcoin/bitcoin/actions/runs/39809026827/job/119929911875#step:14:14454
Author provides an artificial sleep diff to reliably reproduce the failure at ~10% rate with concurrent test runner execution.
problem: The functional test `p2p_orphan_handling.py` intermittently fails in CI because a ping-pong roundtrip does not guarantee that peer cleanup has finished in `TxDownloadManager::DisconnectedPeer`. If the message handling thread holds a reference to a disconnected node, orphan state cleanup is delayed, causing the test to proceed prematurely and fail on subsequent parent request assertions.

risk.why: Only modifies test synchronization logic in a single functional test.

summary: Fix an intermittent failure in the functional test `p2p_orphan_handling.py` by waiting for node orphan state to reflect a peer disconnection. Instead of relying on a ping-pong sync that can complete before peer finalization finishes, the test explicitly waits until `getorphantxs` shows the disconnected peer has been cleared.
